messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert -> <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8241|PD-8241> fired for SERVICE: hosted-inference-high-5xx-rate. Trigger: 1m error rate > 8%

pagerduty: PD-8241 escalated: primary timed out (no acknowledge within 2m). Notifying secondary and manager.

sre_oncall: acked PD-8241 :white_check_mark: taking first look. Current scope: 5xx spike across usa-west region, multiple runtime hosts showing OOM and connection resets.

alex: seeing spikes in L7 errors from runtime pods too. Suspect KV cache thrash after eviction. Pulling logs.

dana: any customer-facing impact yet? CS reported one 500 for an enterprise customer 2m ago. @cs_oncall can you confirm?

cs_oncall: confirmed a support ticket, slow responses and occasional 500s. Customer session id in ticket: cst-9932. Escalating to account owner.

mohit: logs from runtime-3 show repeated GC + OOM messages. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T21:11:02Z runtime-3 kubelet: oom-kill process: python - mem 7.9GB
2026-03-15T21:11:03Z runtime-3 inference: ERROR: failed to allocate kv-cache slot
2026-03-15T21:11:05Z runtime-3 grpc: send failed: connection reset by peer
```

sre_oncall: thanks. Quick mitigation: increasing replicas and offloading to burst pool. Executing scale now.

sre_oncall: ```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment runtime --replicas=12
redwood-runtime autoscale set --pool burst --weight 0.4
```

incident-bot: action logged: manual scale by sre_oncall.

pagerduty: Escalation update: primary acknowledged (sre_oncall) but secondary pinged due to silence window earlier; manager (eng_manager) also paged.

eng_manager: on call now. If scaling doesn't stabilize in 3m, plan B is to route a fraction of traffic to a compatible quantized variant (q4_0) to reduce memory pressure. Can we test canary routing?

dana: please coordinate with routing. @alex can you prepare route change? Keep error budget in mind.

alex: preparing canary route. Will flip 5% -> 20% if health looks good. Applying route config in 60s.

mohit: after scale, heap pressure dropped on runtime-1/2 but runtime-3 still flapping. Possible corrupted cache causing repeated large allocations. Will drain runtime-3.

sre_oncall: draining runtime-3 and cordoning node. ```bash
kubectl -n inference drain node ip-10-0-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

pagerduty: PD-8241 update: secondary acknowledged (mohit). Manager still on page. Escalation cleared once secondary acknowledged.

cs_oncall: customer cst-9932 notified that we're investigating; ETA message sent. No new customer-wide alerts yet.

incident-bot: post-mitigation check in 5m. Please add timeline notes to PD-8241 for postmortem.

alex: Route canary at 5% applied: <https://console.redwood/inference/routes|routes/hosted-inference>. Traffic healthy so far, 0.2% errors on canary. Increasing to 15%.

eng_manager: good. keep an eye on latencies. If q4_0 introduces quality regressions, fallback config is ready.

mohit: drained node cleaned up; suspect process-level leak in runtime-3 container image. I'll redeploy a fresh runtime image with stricter ulimits to avoid OOM while we root cause.

incident-bot: PD-8241: incident marked as "mitigated" by sre_oncall. Please file follow-up: root-cause hypothesis (kv-cache thrash + memory leak), plan for image fix, and a test for cache eviction thresholds.

dana: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short customer communication and post on #status once we confirm customers are stable. :thumbsup:

cs_oncall: customer cst-9932 updated: issue mitigated, monitoring for residual errors.

eng_manager: assigning postmortem: mohit (owner), alex (routing), sre_oncall (mitigation steps). Please include timeline, PD alerts, runbook gaps, and follow-ups for autoscaler thresholds.

sre_oncall: handing off to off-shift oncall in 30m. Leaving notes in PD-8241 and internal runbook.

pagerduty: PD-8241 closed by incident-bot (auto-close after 30m stable).

incident-bot: summary appended: "Mitigation: scaled runtime replicas, drained/flushed faulty node, applied canary routing to quantized variant. Impact: transient 500s for a small set of enterprise requests (~0.8% of total), one escalated support ticket. Owner: mohit. Follow-ups: image fix, eviction threshold tuning, runbook clarity on automatic routing."
